title: Area affected by fires, national total (all vegetation types), Argentina, as reported by the provinces and National Parks and compiled by the Programa Nacional de Estadística Forestal, 2002-2024 (2007 and 2008 not found)
kind: Ground-based agency statistic: area declared by provincial forest services, National Parks (APN), civil defence, fire brigades and police, compiled nationally. Not a satellite product.
publisher: Programa Nacional de Estadística Forestal (Departamento de Estadística Forestal), national environment authority of Argentina (Secretaría de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sustentable - Dirección de Bosques in the 2002-2006 reports; Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sustentable in the 2009-2015 and 2010-2016 series; later yearbooks of the same programme).

notes.coverage: Of the 22 years 2003-2024, 20 were obtained (2003-2006 and 2009-2024). 2007 and 2008 are missing: no publication found. The before period 2003-2011 therefore has 7 of 9 years; the after period 2012-2024 is complete (13 years). 2002 is kept for context only.
notes.publications: Four kinds of publication, all from the same programme: yearly reports 2002-2006 (national total in a summary table), the multi-year 'Series' 2009-2015 and 2010-2016 (one table by jurisdiction, the best source), yearbook chart labels for 2017, and the 2025-edition spreadsheet for 2018-2024 (the latest, revised values). No single publication covers both periods: the longest official multi-year tables found start in 2009 (Series) or 2011 (yearbook figure).
notes.completeness: Reporting is incomplete in a different way each year: Formosa missing in 2010; Buenos Aires missing half of 2012 and half of 2013; Chaco, Neuquén and Tucumán missing in 2019 with Chubut and La Rioja half-year; Mendoza and Río Negro half-year in 2021; six provinces filled in by the Servicio Nacional de Manejo del Fuego in 2022 and Río Negro limited to one department; five jurisdictions missing in 2024 (Buenos Aires, CABA, Corrientes, Santa Fe, Santiago del Estero). For 2002-2006 per-province completeness was not verified tonight; those reports themselves warn about omitted information, erroneous information and areas not covered by informants.
notes.comparability: The totals are sums of whatever each jurisdiction declared that year, so they jump for reporting reasons: one province often makes half the national total (San Luis 58 % in 2009, La Pampa 61 % in 2014 and 57 % in 2016, Buenos Aires 44 % in 2019 from one department, Pampeana region 65 % in 2003), and the same province can report hundreds of thousands of hectares one year and nothing the next (Buenos Aires 301.588 ha in 2019, no report in 2024). Values are revised after publication (2018: 1.021.406 then 1.037.806 ha). A second national compilation of the same reports exists (Servicio Nacional de Manejo del Fuego, open data CIAM dt_id 416, raw/argentina_ciam_dt416_...csv, 2017+) and differs from this one by up to a factor of 2.3 for the same year (2021: 746.826 vs 322.717 ha; 2019: 688.282 vs 479.896 ha). The reports do not describe any method change in 2012, but the 2003-2011 mean is dominated by 2003 (3,15 million ha, more than the next three before-years together), whose provincial completeness could not be checked.
notes.use: Not used in the app. A before/after ratio from this series is computed in scripts/check_argentina_national.mjs only to document how fragile it is.
